sources.title: Home - CyberKnife
sources.snippet: The CyberKnife System is the first and only fully robotic radiotherapy device. CyberKnife uses an approach called stereotactic body radiation therapy (SRS SBRT), delivering precise doses of radiation with extreme accuracy — and accounting for tumor or patient movement in real-time.

sources.title: CyberKnife SRS / SBRT System from Accuray
sources.snippet: With the CyberKnife System from Accuray, you can treat every patient with robotic precision and deliver personalized radiation therapy.
